summary: A banner that shows a message with an icon and optional actions, like a warning or success notice.
description: A message bar element used to display important information to users, with an icon derived from its type, optional heading, dismiss button, actions, and support link.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the displayed message, drives the icon shown. Values with dedicated icon/l10n mappings in code: info, warning, success, error, critical (critical uses the same icon/l10n as error and is a legacy alias — Storybook's documented options list only info/warning/success/error, while the Figma Code Connect file also references "critical" and "information" as design-side type names).

attributes.name: dismissable
attributes.description: Whether the message bar shows a close/dismiss button.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: SUMO support page stub; when set, renders a built-in support link after the message.

attributes.name: messageL10nId
attributes.description: Fluent l10n ID for the message.

attributes.name: messageL10nArgs
attributes.description: JSON-stringified args for the message l10n ID.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: ARIA role for the message bar, reflected as an attribute. Defaults to "alert".

slots.name: message
slots.description: Overrides the message/messageL10nId text content with custom markup (e.g. a message containing an inline link).

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Action buttons (e.g. moz-button elements) shown at the end of the message bar.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Rendered when supportPage is unset, letting callers supply a custom support link.

events.name: message-bar:close
events.description: Fired when the message bar is removed from the DOM (disconnectedCallback), regardless of cause.

events.name: message-bar:user-dismissed
events.description: Fired when the user clicks the dismiss/close button, before the element removes itself; cancelable — calling preventDefault() stops the automatic close().

usage: <moz-message-bar type="warning" heading="Heads up" message="Something needs your attention." dismissable></moz-message-bar>
